methodology.limitation: One annual threshold for all seasons; no seasonal adjustment. This application definition is not an official meteorological heat alert.

regression.interpretation: Descriptive linear event-count change; no significance or causal claim.

insights: Observed totals: 71 event starts and 428 heatwave days in the selected period.
Descriptive event-count slope: +0.04 events per decade across 31 eligible years.
First/last five-year mean event count changed by +0.0% (+0.00 events per year).

counting_metadata.event_count: Complete confirmed events counted in their start year.
counting_metadata.duration: Full duration of complete events starting in the selection/year, including days outside it.
counting_metadata.heatwave_days: Complete-event days allocated to their actual calendar year, including prior-year event starts.
counting_metadata.intensity: Day-weighted mean exceedance across complete-event days inside the selection/year.
counting_metadata.peak: Highest daily maximum across complete-event days inside the selection/year.
counting_metadata.boundary_policy: Truncated events/candidates excluded from standard metrics; affected years incomplete and ineligible for trends.

source.changes: Calendar reconstructed; missing/invalid observations retained as null with flags.
